access.notes: Open-source plane-wave/pseudopotential DFT code; other DFT codes with comparable LDA capabilities may be used.
Use an LDA pseudopotential for Fe from the PSlibrary (e.g., Fe.lda-nl-kjpaw_psl.0.2.1.UPF) or an equivalent norm-conserving/ultrasoft pseudopotential with LDA exchange-correlation.
